title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 — Artificial Intelligence Act
notes: Current consolidated version identified on EUR-Lex. Use the official text for article, annex and applicability analysis.

title: Artificial Intelligence Act — Annex III: High-Risk AI Systems
notes: Relevant source for determining whether AI systems used in employment, worker management or access to self-employment fall within high-risk categories.

title: Artificial Intelligence Act — Article 14: Human Oversight
notes: Relevant to human oversight requirements for high-risk AI systems. Human involvement should be modeled as a fact, not treated as an automatic exemption from high-risk classification.

title: Artificial Intelligence Act — Article 50: Transparency Obligations
notes: Relevant to transparency obligations that apply to certain AI systems and interactions.

title: Artificial Intelligence Act — Applicability and Implementation Timeline
notes: Use current European Commission information to determine which AI Act provisions apply on a given date, including the updated implementation timeline.
